title: Governance metadata field
description: Who's accountable for this entity's docs, and when accuracy was last confirmed. Answers who to ask about conflicts or errors and lets tools flag docs for staleness. Different from `lastUpdated`: that records when the doc changed.

owner.description: Who's accountable for this entity's content. A bare string names the owner. Use the object form to add contact info. A named person goes stale the moment they leave, so wwners SHOULD be teams, roles, or group aliases ('Design Systems', '@acme/design-system'). Tools SHOULD show the owner wherever a reader might need to flag a problem.

oneOf.description: Name or alias of the owning team, role, or group (ex: 'Design Systems', '@acme/design-system').
The owner's name plus a way to reach them.

name.description: Name or alias of the owning team, role, or group (ex: 'Design Systems'). SHOULD name a team or role, not an individual.

contact.description: How to reach the owner: a URL, email, or channel (ex: 'design-system@acme.com', '#design-system'). Freeform; tools SHOULD link it when it parses as a URL or email.

lastReviewed.description: When a person last confirmed this entity's docs are accurate. A bare date ('2026-06-12') covers the common case. Use the object form to record who reviewed it and what they found. A review doesn't have to change anything: confirming the doc is correct updates `lastReviewed` and leaves `lastUpdated` alone. Tools MAY treat an old or missing `lastReviewed` as a staleness signal; agents SHOULD prefer more recently reviewed docs when sources disagree.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent review of this entity's documentation.
The date plus who reviewed it, what version it was checked against, and an optional note on the outcome.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent review of this entity's documentation.

reviewedBy.description: Who did the review: a team, role, or person (ex: 'jane.doe'). Unlike `owner`, naming a person here is fine since the field only serves as a record.

note.description: Plain-text note on the review outcome (ex: 'Verified against v3.1; prop table still accurate', 'Guidelines section needs a rewrite—tracked in DS-412'). MUST NOT contain markup.

reviewedAgainst.description: The version the doc was checked against in this review (ex: '@acme/ui@3.1.0'). Lets tools spot drift. If the code has moved past this version, the doc MAY be stale even if recently reviewed. Lives inside the review record, so it can't exist without one.

governance.description: Who's accountable for this entity's docs, and their review state. `owner` is required. Without one, this field is useless. `lastReviewed` is optional but SHOULD be set once you have a review process. The object records who reviewed it and which version, so a tool can answer 'is this verified, against what, and who vouches for it.'
